# AKD single-axis servo drive: # the AKD Installation Manual Rev AG (May 2022)

120/240 VAC: AKD servo drive 3 A rms with EtherCAT and CANopen
EtherCAT and CANopen. Figures from: 1 axis; EtherCAT or CANopen with CiA 402; continuous 3 Arms; peak 9 Arms for 5 s; supply 1 or 3 phase 100 to 240 VAC; velocity loop 62.5 us; position loop 250 us; feedback X10 HD15 with BiSS-C (Renishaw type; 1 MHz clock); motor PTC on X10; no internal regen (external 33 ohm); bus 940 uF; no internal mains filter; STO 1 channel SIL 2 PL d (self-assessed since 2026-10-01); service port Ethernet X11
column10: Quoted for the AQTUATOR CS stage on 2026-10-30 as the replacement of AKD-P00306-NBEC. Mass not checked.
